name: Practice Pulse
tagline: Practice Management and Professional Issues in Optometry
description: A 15-episode series on the business and ethics of optometry — communication, coding, compliance, and building a sustainable practice that serves patients well.

episodes.title: Building Patient Trust: The First Impression and the Long Game
episodes.description: The trust-building behaviours from the greeting to the discharge, the patient satisfaction drivers, and the retention strategies.

episodes.title: Difficult Conversations: Delivering Bad News and the SPIKES Protocol
episodes.description: The SPIKES framework for delivering bad news (a new glaucoma diagnosis, vision loss), and the empathy and follow-up that support the patient.

episodes.title: Ethical Dilemmas in Eye Care: The Non-Adherent Glaucoma Patient
episodes.description: The ethical framework for the non-compliant patient, the capacity and autonomy principles, and the documentation that protects.

episodes.title: Coding and Billing Fundamentals: E and M Codes for Optometrists
episodes.description: The E and M code levels, the medical decision making components, and the documentation that supports the code level billed.

episodes.title: Documentation Best Practices: The Medical-legal Chart That Protects You
episodes.description: The SOAP note structure, the elements that must be documented, and the avoid-the-plaintiff-lawyer documentation principles.

episodes.title: Medical Necessity for Testing: Why You Ordered the OCT and Visual Field
episodes.description: The medical necessity standard for each diagnostic test, the audit risk of routine testing, and the documentation that justifies the test.

episodes.title: HIPAA Compliance in the EHR Era: Breaches, Encryption, and the Business Associate
episodes.description: The HIPAA security rule, the breach notification protocol, and the business associate agreements with technology vendors.

episodes.title: Building a Specialty Service: Dry Eye, Glaucoma, or Myopia Control
episodes.description: How to build a specialty service line, the equipment and training investment, the marketing strategy, and the patient referral network.

episodes.title: Marketing an Optometry Practice: Digital, Referral, and Community
episodes.description: The digital marketing essentials (website, Google Business Profile, reviews), the referral network building, and the community outreach.

episodes.title: Staff Training and Delegation: The Scope of Practice and the Team
episodes.description: The delegation scope for each staff role (technician, optician), the training and competency assessment, and the supervision requirement.

episodes.title: Telehealth in Optometry: What Can and Cannot Be Done Remotely
episodes.description: The tele-optometry modalities (synchronous, asynchronous, remote monitoring), the reimbursement landscape, and the clinical limitations.

episodes.title: Managing the Aging Patient: Falls, Dementia, and the Caregiver
episodes.description: The fall risk assessment, the dementia-friendly communication, and the caregiver engagement that improves adherence.

episodes.title: Cultural Competence in Eye Care: Language, Health Literacy, and Trust
episodes.description: The cultural humility framework, the interpreter use, and the health literacy assessment and the plain-language communication.

episodes.title: Burnout and Self-Care in Optometry: Recognition and Recovery
episodes.description: The burnout signs and drivers in optometry, the individual and systemic interventions, and the recovery and prevention strategies.

episodes.title: Financial Planning for the Optometry Practice Owner: The Path to Ownership
episodes.description: The practice acquisition financing, the overhead benchmarking, and the key performance indicators that a healthy practice tracks.
